name: BoundlessWorld-CubicChunks (Common Library)
description: Common library for BoundlessWorld-CubicChunks. Fabric-loom requires a fabric.mod.json so this submodule pulls Minecraft and the Mixin runtime onto its compile classpath; the loader-specific mods (fabric-1_21, neoforge-1_21, fabric-26, neoforge-26) are the actual mod entry points.
